ITA-5.62.31 jatumaṇiḥ जतुमणिः
Mole, birthmark
A disorder characterized by a painless circular lesion; slightly raised from skin surface; minute lesion; reddish or reddish tinged; smooth-textured lesion; resembles carmakīla; present since birth/congenital.

jatrumūlam जत्रुमूलम्
Base of the neck

ITA-3.16.11 Śiromarma, jatrūrdhvamarma शिरोमर्म, जत्रूर्ध्वमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) in the head and neck
Marma located in the head and neck..

ITA-9.4.20 jātakarma जातकर्म
Care of newborn
The various procedures undertaken in the care of a newborn baby.

ITA-9.4.25 jātakarmasaṁskāraḥ जातकर्मसंस्कारः
Postnatal ritual
A ritual performed soon after birth for the purpose of promoting intellect, longevity and strength in the baby.

ITA-9.4.9 sadyojāta/ jātamātraḥ सद्योजातः/जातमात्रः
Newborn
The neonate soon after birth.
